title: PRD 0.7: the bank's own regulations (D-89) as requirements, scenarios and stubs
goal: D-89's scope item and the bank's own records exist in PRD.md as a requirement group with IDs, acceptance criteria and a golden path, and in the owning app.md files as scenarios with skipped stubs and fixme journeys, so later packages build them.
acceptance: requirements_coverage.py and compliance_check.py --all pass; PRD has version row 0.7, the OWN group, AC-OWN1, AC-OWN2 and J-12 in section 5; every new @integration scenario has a @skip('pending: <ID>') test and every @e2e one a test.fixme journey importing test from support/api-guard with its ID in the title (FP-S19's title carries J-12 @smoke); INV-07 no longer names the tenant's own sources and INV-S9 and AGT-S14 name no private source and no tenant key; D-91 (answered by default) and ADR 0059 exist, the ADR naming the runner-event channel; D-75's PRD section 6 edit is in.
brief:
Docs and stubs only. Read CLAUDE.md, PRD.md, docs/DECISIONS.md rows D-57, D-75, D-76, D-89 and ADRs 0050 and 0053 first. D-89 (Alex, 2026-09-24) already puts this feature in R2 and says its PRD text lands with the R2 plan, so you write it and record the details as D-91, answered by default, with a TODO box for Alex to confirm; nothing waits on that box. Quote Alex's D-89 words verbatim in the 0.7 version row and in each touched app.md context: "an agent can always add things to the library, and then another agent can verify it, its then up to the tenant to decide if they want to use it or not" and "The previously called 'footprint' can not be agent managed, only a tenant admin can add things that the agents should look out for or regulations that apply to them", and cite D-89's decision that a bank's people may add a regulation or area the library does not yet cover, that the bank's own agents research it and fill the bank's own library zone with regulation and control inventories as proposals, and that the bank's people approve or reject them as the shared queue works.
1. PRD.md section 3, new group '### OWN: the bank's own regulations' in the existing table format: OWN-01 (M,R2) a scope item (name, jurisdiction and regime terms, official reference, public source addresses) is added through the regulatory scope request: footprint.request asks, a different person with footprint.approve approves with a passkey, no API key reaches it, approving widens no term, and no agent ever writes one. OWN-02 (M,R2) the bank's own agent (a bleqq-authored tenant-scoped definition switched on under AGT-04) researches an approved item from public sources and files the bank's own instruments and obligations as proposals, a source per field; its findings reach the bank's queue only as runner events applied in the worker, never through an API key; it never writes or re-tags the shared library, never writes the regulatory scope, and never reads the bank's own records back (D-57): a duplicate by official reference answers 409 already_in_our_library. OWN-03 (M,R2) the bank's own queue: approve or reject under private_records.approve with a passkey, never the proposer, a reason on reject; platform staff never see it. OWN-04 (M,R2) own records read 'Private to us', only to that bank; never indexed, never a model input, never agent access (an agent-access answer says how many it left out), never a support session; the register sets applicability and status on them as on shared obligations; when the library later covers the item nothing changes automatically. OWN-05 (S,R2) the agent may propose a private obligation's controls as REG-05 linked internal items of the control kind, approved the same way (waits for Alex's answer on what a control inventory is). Move INV-07 to R2 (M) as OWN's minimum and reword it: tenant-private instruments and obligations, proposed by the bank's own agents or its compliance officers and approved inside that bank by a second person; private sources stay WAT-06, R3. Point AGT-04, AGT-05 and PRO-03 at OWN. Section 4: AC-OWN1 (nothing a bank writes as its own record reaches the index, a model input, the console queue or tenant B, who gets 404), AC-OWN2 (the scope item request refuses the requester as approver with 409 four_eyes_violation and refuses every key). Section 5: J-12 (officer adds a scope item, a second person approves with a passkey, the bank's agent on the mock runner files private proposals, an approver approves one with a passkey, it reads 'Private to us' in the inventory, tenant B's URL answers 404). Section 6 (D-75): delete the applicability.request row and exclude applicability.approve from the four-eyes sentence; add private_records.approve's use for the bank's own queue.
2. app.md rows (pending) and Gherkin headed per CLAUDE.md section 10: taxonomy FP-S18 (scope item request, @integration @e2e) and FP-S19 (J-12, @e2e); agents AGT-S16 (@integration: an approved item opens a research request; the run's findings arrive as owned proposals through runner events; a duplicate answers 409) and AGT-S14 reworded (a bank's run, opened by the worker with no key, never writes the shared library; its re-tag request is refused; what it files carries owner_tenant_id; drop 'under tenant A's key' and 'private source'); proposals PRO-S15 (@integration @e2e), PRO-S12 moved to R2 as written (a person's private-record kind, ADR 0050); library INV-S15 (@integration @e2e), INV-S9 moved to R2 with its Given reworded to an obligation the bank's own agent proposed and a second person approved (no private source), INV-S13 moved to R2 with its tenant-exit clause split out as a chunk 12 note; register REG-S17 (@integration). Stubs: @skip tests and test.fixme journeys importing test from support/api-guard.
3. SCOPE_ITEMS.md: the design, including that only keys reach a model until Alex answers the tenant-text question. ADR 0059 (accepted under D-89, details answered by default in D-91): pulls ADR 0050's private-door tranches 1 and 2 into R2 (tranche 3, private sources, stays chunk 13), supersedes CHUNK11 ruling 2 for OWN, keeps D-57, leaves D-07/D-32 open, and fixes the channel: a tenant run's findings reach the bank's queue only as runner events applied in the worker with owner_tenant from the run; no API key gains a proposal scope and refuse_tenant_key is unchanged. TODO entry 'D-89: confirm PRD 0.7's OWN group' (non-blocking). One-line notes in Build_Plan, IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS, CHUNK11_TASKS, CHUNK13_TASKS.
Leave alone: CLAUDE.md and production code. Shared files: your own block only. Do not run the suite or E2E (D-67).
